name: An act ends
what: At each quarter of the reign the act just gone is told back: your weightiest choices where they happened, then the name you're earning and how your ambitions stand. The realm waits until you click on.

versions.label: New: the act told back
versions.what: The first act ends: 'So far, history would name you the Golden. Close behind: the Builder. Your ambitions: 0 of 3 fulfilled.' Fun bar, The reign has a shape: from no acts to four, each closing on this.

versions.label: A real choice told back, panels away
versions.what: The first act ends on a choice the King made: 'Autumn of 309, House Thornvale: you wed their blood into a great house. They stand by you for it.' The side panels, minimap and camera pad step away for the telling.

name: The court, a house's ultimatum

versions.label: The court sits, the realm holds
versions.what: The court sits and the realm holds still. Under the date, the name being earned and three ambitions (◇◇◇).

name: After a ruling
what: The court closes, the realm moves, and what the King's ruling set going is offered to watch.

versions.label: The doors close, the feast is on
versions.what: Answered with a feast: Thornvale's favour 53 → 68 in the houses table, 'A feast at Kingsmere · Watch', and the wedding feast in the town.

name: A battle
what: Battles fought by the men in them: each man closes, fights, reels, falls or breaks; knights charge, ride through and come round again.

versions.label: Men fight on their own, two attack clips
versions.what: First cut on the new battle mind: the fight works, but every man repeats the same two attacks (the jumping slash). Your note.

versions.label: Every fight move, with answers
versions.what: Each man varies his cuts (five slashes, two thrusts, a kick); the other parries, dodges or reels on the same frame; men fall the way the blow drives them; the beaten break sooner and some wounded yield. Part of the run; the full film follows.

versions.label: Dead stay down, sides in colour
versions.what: Every man now moves through Godot's animation state machine, whose Dead state nothing leaves: the fallen stay down. Each army wears its house's colour (green against tan), knights ride through and come round, the beaten break and their standard falls, the victors cheer.

versions.label: Every man in the fight, legs on the ground
versions.what: The ranks behind push in on their own count instead of standing for the whole fight; legs follow how fast each man really moves (no running on the spot, no gliding); the crowd moves through Godot's avoidance so nobody walks through anyone; the camera stays on the fight.

versions.label: In close on the blows
versions.what: The camera takes the fight in turns: close on the blows, where each man, shield and fall reads, then back out on the whole melee. At one distance it read as a blob of small men.

versions.label: Today's round: map decisions, gold, motion v2, weather

name: A siege
what: Kingsmere under siege: engines, the besiegers' camp, assault parties going to the wall and back.

versions.label: Assault parties on LimboAI
versions.what: Each attacker has his own state machine: waits in camp, goes forward behind his shield, runs the last stretch, fights at the foot of the wall with varied cuts and guards, falls back, or is cut down and stays down while the camp sends a fresh man.

versions.label: The camera goes in on each rush
versions.what: When a party is sent at the wall, the camera comes in low from the camp side on that stretch, so the fight at the foot of the wall reads.

name: A castle's courtyard
what: Kingsmere's bailey: the yard inside the castle walls.

versions.label: Furnished, seen from above
versions.what: Barn, carts, hay, a fire pit and a log pile in the yard, but nobody there, the house blocking the gate, and the camera only able to look down from over the walls.

versions.label: Lived in, and the camera can come into the yard
versions.what: The garrison drills under a sergeant, a groom warms at the fire, a servant carries; the house moved off the gate; the yard is open air to the camera, so it comes down inside.

versions.label: The drill out in the open
versions.what: The garrison drills in the open half of the yard, clear of the keep's shadow, each at his own move, the sergeant facing them from the gate side.

versions.label: The fire is lit, the garrison in red
versions.what: A low fire burns in the pit with a warm glow on the grass and a thread of smoke, and the soldiers in the yard wear their lord's colour.

name: A town up close
what: Goldrock's square with the camera close in.

versions.label: Looking down from above
versions.what: Clearing the roofs, the camera climbed until it looked about 55 degrees down: roofs, not the town.

versions.label: Low and oblique
versions.what: Past 42 degrees the camera steps back along its line instead of climbing: walls, stalls and people read.

versions.label: Mourning in small knots
versions.what: Your call: a grieving town mourns in knots of two or three at their own doors, never one crowd in the square. The hungry keep in small knots round the town's edge too. The square is busy again, not a press.

versions.label: Smoke over everyone

versions.label: A thin drifting haze

name: A town changes hands
what: The old lord's banner falls, the new lord's men march in, his banner rises.

versions.label: Hidden behind the church
versions.what: The camera looked across the town's tall church; the scene in the square was a blur behind it.

versions.label: From a clear side
versions.what: Before framing any scene the camera picks a side with no tall building in the way (and fells trees on that side). The new lord's men march in, his banner rises, they salute and cheer.

name: A muster
what: A lord's men form up under his banners and march out.

versions.label: A tower in the way
versions.what: A castle tower filled the front of the shot: the clear-view check didn't count buildings of unknown height or the stretch nearest the lens.

versions.label: In clear view
versions.what: The camera finds a side with no tall building anywhere along its line of sight; the ranks form in the square and march out in a column.

name: The King's grain on the road
what: A grain convoy from Kingsmere to the nearest town, the camera riding along.

versions.label: In the leaves
versions.what: Following the cart along a forest road, the camera sat inside the tree canopy for about 15 seconds.

versions.label: Above the canopy
versions.what: Whenever tree crowns stand between the lens and what it follows, the camera rises over the canopy (forest.gd's sight lines). The escort hails the town on arrival.

versions.label: A cart track through the wood
versions.what: A convoy over land with no road cuts a track through any wood it crosses, so the cart runs over open ground. Still open: near the coast town the camera looks down through one tree crown by the river.

versions.label: Low and clear of the leaves
versions.what: Following the cart, the camera turns each second to a side with no tree crowns in the way (the director's own choice in play), so it stays low and oblique with the cart and its track in view, instead of steep over a wood with leaves filling the frame. Still open: at the coast town a house can stand between the camera and the cart.

name: Court
what: 0.6: the petitioner in front of you waits three seasons; the bar under the card drains.

versions.label: Before
After
One court, a sitting each spring
versions.what: The court sits once a year, in spring, with two or three matters. The Hand speaks on each petitioner's card in one line.

versions.label: A paused court, when it has matters
versions.what: The court sits when it has something worth hearing (one matter early, up to three at the climax); the realm and the reign's clock hold still while it sits; Later sets the card aside, Close the court lets silence settle the rest. Fun bar, Room to breathe (timed 15-minute reign, 6.5 min measured): before 3.6 decisions a minute, the Hand's card always up (≈0% quiet); after 1.08 a minute, 86% quiet.
